description: This PHP class 'testcaseCommands' handles operations related to test case management within a testing framework. It provides methods for creating, editing, deleting, and managing test cases and their steps, as well as handling related entities such as keywords, platforms, and relations. The class also manages GUI data initialization, validation, and presentation logic, serving as a controller for test case functionalities.

classes.name: testcaseCommands
classes.description: Controller class managing test case operations, GUI preparation, and related entity management within a testing framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class with database connection, user object, and test project ID. Sets up permissions and loads necessary tables.

methods.name: setTemplateCfg
methods.description: Sets the template configuration for the class.

methods.name: initGuiBean
methods.description: Initializes GUI data object with default values and user permissions.

methods.name: initTestCaseBasicInfo
methods.description: Loads basic test case info, author, updater, and custom fields for GUI display.

methods.name: create

methods.name: doCreate

methods.name: edit

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Updates test case information.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status (e.g., active, inactive) for a test case version.
